newsitem.title: SPAIN: Vallehermoso says wants ROE above 6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vallehermoso says wants ROE above 6 pct.

text.p: Spanish property firm Vallehermoso hopes to increase its return on equity (ROE) to above the current level of six percent, officials said on Thursday.

"The challenge is to obtain substantial growth, not in line with inflation but above, and to place (ROE) by the year 2000 at the level of the cost of capital and long-term interest rates" said director general Jose Luis Rodriguez Flecha.

Chairman Martin Eyries Valmaseda said shareholder returns are currently at "reasonable" levels, adding that the firm intends to increase earnings per share (EPS), although he did not specify whether this would mean an increase in payout.
"The problem is whether we pay (an increase in dividend) or whether this is applied to self-financing, but we will try to increase EPS," Eyries said.

He added that the property market is performing well as of the fourth quarter last year, and predicted good prospects after Europe's single currency is introduced on expected rising demand by foreigners for Spanish property.
